statement: Existing independently reverse-engineered Triton source describes buffered audio-like haptic streaming with status and fill-level events. Its reviewed source records do not establish a physical speaker/microphone USB Audio Class interface, a verified host-output/audio endpoint, or captured waveform acceptance. Preserve sc2-gap-audio as inferred; unlike Xbox xpad or Switch HIDAPI, these data do not justify asserting audio is simply absent.

applicability.scope: Corroborates the uncertainty boundary of existing claim sc2-gap-audio without modifying that claim. Source-only implementation hypotheses; no physical capture or consumer ALSA endpoint enumeration.
